requirements.evidence: Both parts reference the identical junction (0,0 + 0,1 + 1,0) and are placed simultaneously; check_build meshClash clear, look from above shows spike stud adjacent to drawer frame with no gap; house rules capOpenFaces + lockJoints applied.

finish.summary: Built triangular cluster of 3 full bases (0,0 + 1,0 + 0,1) to create a 3-way junction. Placed spike at that junction (47.8,82.9) and drawer-frame notch (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf) in the facing empty cell 1,1 k=2 that touches the same corner, so drawer and spike meet at the same point. Verified mesh clear and applied caps/joint bolts.

M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
